Launch an autonomous agent for complex, multi-step tasks. Prefer direct tools for known paths, searches, parsing, and tests; do not delegate mechanical work. Agent types:
{{compactTypeList}}

Custom agents: .pi/agents/<name>.md (project) or {{agentDir}}/agents/<name>.md (global).

Notes:
- description: 3-5 words (shown in UI). Prompts must be self-contained — the agent has not seen this conversation.
- Parallel work: one message, multiple Agent calls — they run concurrently.
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass run_in_background: false only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — if the user asks before the notification arrives, say it's still running.
- Results are not shown to the user; summarize relevant findings. Verify claimed code changes with local diff/tests, not another agent.
- resume continues a previous agent by ID; steer_subagent messages a running one.{{isolationCompactGuideline}}
